resources.string: UltimateLauncher is NOT the default launcher yet.
Allow UltimateLauncher to run in the background so widgets keep updating. If your phone has no dedicated screen, the app details page opens instead.
The file lists the apps installed on this phone, which is sensitive information. You can encrypt it with a passphrase (AES-256-GCM). No network is used: pick any place in the system document picker.
Imported. A copy of the previous layout was saved as %1$s.
This file uses schema %1$d, newer than this app supports.
Wrong passphrase, or the file was altered.
Removes all apps from the dock recents.
Shows the last apps opened from this launcher (up to 4). Stored only on this device; turning it off deletes them.
Shows translucent pills behind the dock icons. Off: icons only.
Apps grow from the tapped icon. Off: AOSP reveal animation.
The icon you launched pops back when you return to the launcher. The app window itself is closed by the system.
Without this, the system (ColorOS, EMUI, MagicOS...) may kill the launcher in the background and the home screen reloads (blank icons for a moment) when you come back.
Don\'t optimize battery for the launcher
Battery optimization is OFF for UltimateLauncher (good).
Battery optimization is ON: the system may kill the launcher.
Animates the return to the icon after the swipe-up gesture. Off by default: on ColorOS it can leave the icons hidden for a moment.
No card: title on top, icons over the blurred wallpaper and the rest of the home screen hidden.
Follows the system orientation so the grid, dock and folders also work in landscape. Off by default (portrait home like OPPO).
No room to expand this folder
Long-press a folder on the home screen to expand it to 2x2: its apps show on the tile and open with one tap.
Large time on a rounded card, with the day and date. Tap to open the clock app.
